verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
TUSIGA-ensigo-ennungi
Mu nnimiro zaffe,
Naye Katonda-azikuzaza
N'azifukirira.
Ayasa omusana
N'atonnyesa-enkuba
Empewo ne zikunta,
Ebimeza-ensigo.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Byonna bye tulina,
(E)bitwetoolodde
Katonda olw'ekisa kye,
Ye atugabira.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Katonda ye yatonda.
Byonna bye tulaba;
-Ebimuli n'ebimera
Byonna byonna ku nsi;
Empewo-era n'ennyanja,
N'ebirimu byonna,
Ennyonyi-ez'omu bbanga
N'ensolo-ez'omu nsi.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Byonna bye tulina,
(E)bitwetoolodde
Katonda olw'ekisa kye,
Ye atugabira.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Kale ka tumwebaze,
Katonda waffe-oyo
Olw'emere n'obulamu-
N'olw'okukungula;
Naffe tuwaayo-ebyaffe
Olw'okukwebaza;
Toola-obulamu bwaffe
Bwe tukuwa leero.

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Byonna bye tulina,
(E)bitwetoolodde
Katonda olw'ekisa kye,
Ye atugabira.
